summary: Defines a Sieve extension that adds a test for whether a special-use attribute is assigned to a mailbox, based on the IMAP SPECIAL-USE capability from RFC 6154. It also lets a filter deliver mail into a mailbox identified by its special use. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Email filters can find the folder called 'Junk' or 'Sent' by its job instead of its name, even when it is named differently in another language.

questions: deliver to junk folder with sieve
